whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Pranjal Family Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has been serving guests on New Dak Bunglow Rd in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur popular dishes showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/pranjal

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Pranjal Family Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with online table reservations and direct WhatsApp food ordering for your location on New Dak Bunglow Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
